units.source_text: 古歌：“思君心切频寻梦，返着睡衣独自眠。”

en.t: An old poem says, "Longing for you so deeply, I seek you again and again in dreams, and sleep alone with my nightclothes turned inside out."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 当时习惯：思念某人时，只要将睡衣反穿而就睡，便会梦见此人。

en.t: According to the custom of the time, when one longed for someone, one had only to put on one's nightclothes inside out and go to sleep, and one would dream of that person.

units.source_text: 末摘花诗中言“欲返春衫”，意思是要把衣服还给他。

en.t: When Suetsumuhana's poem says that she wishes to return the spring robe, it means that she wants to give the clothing back to him.

units.source_text: 源氏故意引证古歌，将此“返”字解释作反穿睡衣。

en.t: Genji deliberately cites the old poem and interprets the word "return" here as turning one's nightclothes inside out.
